description: This Java source file defines the class PreparedKamonTimer, a Kamon-based implementation of the PreparedTimer interface. It provides functionality to create, configure, and record timing metrics with associated tags, as well as retrieve timing summaries and reset the timer.

classes.name: PreparedKamonTimer
classes.description: Implementation of PreparedTimer using Kamon to record and manage timing metrics.

methods.name: newTimer
methods.description: Factory method to create a new PreparedKamonTimer instance with the specified name.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the timer.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds or updates a single tag key-value pair.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer, returning a StartedTimer instance.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a specific duration into the timer.

methods.name: getNumberOfRecords
methods.description: Retrieves the number of recorded measurements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Attempts to reset the timer, returning success or failure.

methods.name: getSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the timer's data, optionally resetting after retrieval.

methods.name: getKamonInternalTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the Kamon Timer object with applied tags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the timer instance.
